title: data-layer-redis
description: Framework-agnostic Redis cache service for the data-layer stack. Owns the redis server install + tenant-prefix key isolation + bounded read-through cache. Holds no framework-specific code (no Agent Zero plugin, no adapter glue). Wired into the data-layer umbrella via shell-out from `data-layer/bootstrap redis`.
instructions:
## data-layer-redis — Isolated Cache Engineering Workspace

ACTIVE WORKSPACE: /a0/usr/projects/data-layer/data-layer-redis. This is the authoritative workspace for the redis component of the data-layer stack: redis server install, tenant-prefix key setup, bounded read-through cache contract, and project-local evidence.

## Scope and ownership

This project owns the redis server install (`lib/redis.sh`), the idempotent applier (`lib/install.sh`), the cache-abstraction contract (`docs/cache-abstraction.md`), the ADRs under `docs/decisions/`, and project-local Agent Zero metadata. It does NOT own postgres, falkordb, the framework adapters, or the data-layer umbrella — those live in their own sibling projects.

## Isolation and security

Keep plans, scripts, configs, tests, docs, and evidence inside this workspace. Never write real secrets to source-controlled files; use `.env.example` for placeholders. Do not modify files in `/a0`, the parent `../data-layer/`, other sibling submodules, global plugins, system services, or live databases unless the user explicitly requests the integration and the side effect is reported.

## Required workflow

Before consequential changes, read `README.md`, `docs/cache-abstraction.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.a0proj/instructions/project-isolation.md`. State the intended outcome and affected paths before implementation. Keep deployment state separate from source.

## Runtime boundary

Use `/opt/venv-a0/bin/python` for Agent Zero framework and plugin-hook checks. Use `/opt/venv/bin/python` for task or user-code checks. Do not treat one runtime as proof of the other.

## Canonical references

README.md — commands and environment variables. `lib/redis.sh` — server install. `lib/install.sh` — applier (install | verify | status | reset). `docs/cache-abstraction.md` — read-through cache contract. `docs/decisions/` — append-only ADRs.
